title: UAPI: crypto2dev_status._reserved not validated on input
description: ioctl_status (crypto2dev_fd.c) does not check that crypto2dev_status._reserved[24] is all-zero before processing. Any nonzero value should return -EINVAL. Without this check, future semantics cannot be assigned to these bytes — any caller that sets them will be silently accepted today and may produce unexpected behavior when the field is given meaning in a future version.
